message: Campaign c-20261011-002156-7879 starting: 5 rounds (auto, auto, auto, auto, auto).

Change evidence: pod payment-service-b6f875b8d-6jctr CPU limit is 25m vs declared 500m; pod payment-service-b6f875b8d-njmg9 CPU limit is 25m vs declared 500m.

payment-service recovered: detected in 14.82s, mitigated in 7.71s, fully back to its normal operating band in 50.01s (target 90s — MET). Users saw 0 failed requests out of 1282 (0.0%) during the incident.
